# All Star Medical

> A Nashville-based medical equipment supplier offering mobility aids, lift systems, accessibility solutions, and rental services for seniors and individuals with mobility challenges.

All Star Medical specializes in mobility equipment and accessibility solutions for the Nashville, TN area, including lift chairs, mobility scooters, stair lifts, wheelchairs, and patient lifts. The company offers both sales and rental services, along with professional installation and repair support.

## Primary Mobility Equipment

- [Mobility Scooters](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/mobility-equipment/mobility-scooters): Mobility scooters product category with Golden, Pride options
- [Lift Chairs](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/lifts/lift-chairs): Lift chairs product category with 50+ models in Nashville
- [Stair Lifts](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/lifts/stair-lifts): Stair lifts with local installation in Nashville, TN
- [Power Wheelchairs](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/mobility-equipment/power-wheelchairs): Power wheelchairs including portable and heavy-duty options
- [Wheelchairs](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/mobility-equipment/wheelchairs): Lightweight and portable wheelchairs with transport options

## Accessibility & Home Care Equipment

- [Wheelchair Ramps](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/mobility-equipment/wheelchair-aluminum-ramps): Aluminum wheelchair ramps with modular and portable options
- [Hospital Beds](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/medical-equipment/hospital-beds): Adjustable hospital beds for home care in Nashville area
- [Patient Lifts](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/lifts/patient-lifts): Patient lifts including sit-to-stand and Hoyer lift models
- [Bathroom Safety Equipment](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/bathroom-safety-equipment): Bathroom safety equipment including grab bars and commodes
- [Vertical Platform Lifts](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/lifts/vertical-platform-lifts): Vertical platform and porch lifts for accessibility

## Mobility Aids & Personal Care

- [Walkers, Rollators & Canes](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/mobility-equipment/walkers-rollators): Walkers, knee walkers, rollators, and canes for mobility
- [Scooter Lifts](https://www.allstarmedicalllc.com/product-category/lifts/scooter-lifts): Vehicle scooter lifts with manual and electric options
